Accuracy rises slowly with total steps (~0.2 pp per 0.5 epoch, about 1.5–2.7 s/pp). Tip E036: 5.31 s, 0.7532 on seeds 0–2. Fresh seeds 13–22 gave 0.7525 for this recipe, so the population mean is ~0.752–0.753, only 0.2–0.3 pp over the 0.75 bar. The tip sits at the accuracy cliff.

Mechanisms:
1. Early low resolution is cheap (E026, E033). The 32 px tail and the 3×3 final-map regime carry accuracy (E011, E018, E024).
2. Memory-bound cuts save more than their MAC share (E028, E034, E036). With the group-1 LR annealed, a freeze at 75% is nearly free. E037 shows the dose is nonlinear: 60% cost ~0.4 pp for ~0.25 s. 75% is near the knee. E039 (BN fold) was ~0.03 s for −0.15 pp, so it is not worth it.
3. Averaging, LS, warmup and Lookahead-interval tweaks (E025, E029, E030, E032) are null or negative by 0.2–0.7 pp. The recipe is in a narrow local optimum, so shade any non-systems change by about −0.1 pp.
4. wd ×0.5 helped ~0.2 pp (E016). Muon's gain is confounded with batch size and an RNG re-draw (E006).
5. Systems work is worth ~1% each. Remaining systems levers are ≲0.1 s each.
6. Sample dropping (E031) costs ~0.4 pp for ~0.5 s, worse than the epoch dial.

Noise: 3-seed accuracy SE ~0.1–0.15 pp. Held-out 10-seed SE ~0.06 pp. Time noise ±0.03 s. Any RNG change re-rolls seeds 0–2. Seeds 3–12 carry a winner's curse of ~0.05–0.1 pp.

Misses: E034 and E037 times (memory-bound savings are larger than I modelled) and the accuracy cost of the deeper freeze.

Unsure: the true tip mean; whether anything cheap adds accuracy margin; PCIe transfer of bandwidth-bound levers. Any further time cut needs an accuracy booster that has not been found, so most trims will land below 0.753.

forecasts.reason: Diagnostic with no recipe change; it only reports the profile. The tip's numbers are unchanged.
The 24→20 px change saves ~0.05 s but costs ~0.1–0.2 pp. The tip is already at the cliff, so it likely fails the keep gate.
A 12-step trim costs ~0.1 s and ~0.1–0.2 pp. The non-uniform version might lose a bit less, but the held-out mean is unlikely to reach 0.7545.
An earlier partial freeze lands on the E037 side of the knee, so the accuracy loss likely exceeds the gain.
Moving 5% of steps to the frozen state saves ~0.06 s and costs ~0.1 pp. That fails the 0.7545 gate.
BN recalibration may help by ~0.1 pp for ~0.04 s. The gain is uncertain, and the 0.15 pp gate is borderline.
16 px on a short phase saves ~0.04 s. The accuracy cost is probably small but not zero.
A math-identical cleanup should save ~0.03 s on trial 0, and per-seed accuracies stay bit-identical.

cruxes: Is the tip's true population mean at least 0.753? If it is ~0.7525, every trim fails the gate and only systems work or accuracy boosters remain.
How much of the step is still memory-bound on the 31×31 maps after the freeze and whitening detach (I058 profile)? That sets whether any lever worth more than 0.1 s is left.
Does the PCIe judge's lower power cap shift the value of the bandwidth-bound levers, and does the official 40-seed mean clear 0.75?
